The selected sources preserve personal distinction alongside shared naming, presence, and divine work.
Earlier presence can require distance and mediation; the final vision announces direct dwelling and the removal of death and tears.

John’s Gospel and Pentecost press on sending, authority, unity, seeing, worship, prayer, and Spirit.
